---
id: greater-horseshoe-bat
title: Greater horseshoe bat
---
The greater horseshoe bat (*Rhinolophus ferrumequinum*) takes moths and
beetles after dusk. It emits frequency-modulated ultrasonic pulses from
the larynx through a horseshoe noseleaf and reads echo delay and Doppler
shift with outsized pinnae (biosonar). Constant-frequency components lock
onto insect wingbeats. Colonies occupy caves and old buildings in Europe
and Asia.
